verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a versioned REST API (v1/events endpoint, api-docs.inngest.com) and a doc on function versioning without breaking migrations, but no evidence of a documented deprecation policy for the API itself, and probes for OpenAPI/spec files return 404s. Missing for 10: an explicit deprecation policy document, API changelog with deprecation timelines, and versioned API spec (OpenAPI) confirming version support windows.
